location_exception_reason: Prefabricated guest houses are industrial/institutional accommodation units sold nationwide; location is a logistics/delivery detail, not a buyer decision factor. GI-tagged or regional-origin status is not a defining attribute of this product category.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product meaning unchanged — it is still a prefabricated guest house regardless of seller classification.
